messages.content: Write a contemporary American fiction scene between two adult friends who have a quiet mutual attraction that neither has directly acknowledged. Keep the scene grounded in an ordinary setting. Let the attraction appear through small choices, pauses, attention, and subtext rather than declarations or melodrama. Do not turn the scene into a different style.

Jordan set the takeout bag on the counter and checked inside.

“You got my order right.”

“I usually do.” Alex took off his jacket. “You only have three things you order.”

“That makes it easier.”

“Apparently.”

She smiled and handed him a drink. Their fingers touched for a second, and she pulled her hand back before she had a reason to.

“You're quiet,” he said.

“Long day.”

“That bad?”

“Not bad. Just long.”

He nodded and opened the container for her without asking. She watched him push the lid aside and set a fork next to it.

“You remembered.”

“You always forget utensils.”

“I do not.”

He looked at the untouched drawer beside her.

Jordan laughed. “Okay. Maybe once.”

“More than once.”

She sat down at the table. “You keeping score?”

“Only when it helps me win.”

She looked at him for a beat longer than she meant to.

“What?” he asked.

“Nothing.”

He smiled, but didn't press.

Jordan took a bite and looked down at her food so she wouldn't have to explain why she was smiling.
